    "00:03.000 — Another block begins separating at the hand beside the green block; the two stationary blue blocks persist.",
    "00:03.250, 00:03.500, 00:03.750 — Numbered blocks: 4. The hand separates another block from the manipulated green block. This is another same-kind multiplication; the three stationary blocks remain. The held block changes color but remains a numbered toy block.",
    "00:04.000 — A fifth block is partly visible at the hand beside the newly placed yellow block.",
    "00:04.250, 00:04.500, 00:04.750 — Numbered blocks: 5. The hand separates and places a pale-blue block beside the yellow block; same-kind multiplication. The four other blocks remain present.",
    "00:05.000 — A sixth block begins separating behind and to the right of the pale-blue block at the hand.",
    "00:05.250, 00:05.500, 00:05.750 — Numbered blocks: 6. The hand moves the additional block rightward; same-kind multiplication. Its color changes toward green without changing object kind. The five stationary blocks persist.",
    "00:06.000 — A seventh block is partly visible at the hand beside the newly placed green block marked 5.",
    "00:06.250, 00:06.500 — Numbered blocks: 7. Another block separates at the hand; same-kind multiplication. The six blocks already in the row remain present.",
    "00:06.750, 00:07.000, 00:07.250, 00:07.500, 00:07.750 — Numbered blocks: 8. The hand separates a blue block beside the seventh, green block; same-kind multiplication. Seven blocks stay in the row while the eighth is rotated and placed.",
    "00:08.000, 00:08.250, 00:08.500, 00:08.750, 00:09.000, 00:09.250, 00:09.500, 00:09.750 — Numbered blocks: 8. The hand touches and aligns existing blocks without adding or removing any. No unmanipulated block changes count, and no block becomes a different kind of object."
